description: This file defines the editor store for the Notesnook project, managing editor sessions, tabs, and related state, including session handling, tab navigation, and synchronization with the database.

classes.name: EditorStore
classes.description: Manages editor sessions, tabs, and related state, including session hydration, navigation, and synchronization with database events.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves a session by ID, optionally filtered by session types.

methods.name: getSessionsForNote
methods.description: Returns all sessions associated with a specific note ID.

methods.name: getTabsForNote
methods.description: Returns all tabs associated with a specific note ID.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the store, sets up event subscriptions, and restores the active session.

methods.name: rehydrateSession
methods.description: Rehydrates a session by its ID, opening it in the editor.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates properties of a session by ID.

methods.name: activateSession
methods.description: Activates a session, optionally focusing on a specific block.

methods.name: openDiffSession
methods.description: Opens a diff session comparing current and historical content.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a note or trash item in a new or existing session, with options for force, raw content, and active block.

methods.name: openSessionInTab
methods.description: Opens a note in a specific tab.

methods.name: focusNextTab
methods.description: Focuses the next tab.

methods.name: focusPreviousTab
methods.description: Focuses the previous tab.

methods.name: focusLastActiveTab
methods.description: Focuses the last active tab.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back in tab session history.

methods.name: goForward
methods.description: Navigates forward in tab session history.

methods.name: goToSession
methods.description: Navigates to a specific session in a tab.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new session to the store.

methods.name: saveSession
methods.description: Saves the current state of a session, including content and metadata.

methods.name: saveSessionContentIfNotSaved
methods.description: Saves session content if it has not been saved yet.

methods.name: newSession
methods.description: Creates a new empty session.

methods.name: closeActiveTab
methods.description: Closes the currently active tab.

methods.name: closeAllTabs
methods.description: Closes all open tabs.

methods.name: closeNotes
methods.description: Closes all tabs associated with specified note IDs.

methods.name: closeTabs
methods.description: Closes specified tabs by ID.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of a session.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles properties like favorite, pinned, readonly, localOnly, or color for a session.

methods.name: saveSessionContent
methods.description: Saves the content of a session.

methods.name: setSaveState
methods.description: Sets the save state of a session.

methods.name: toggleProperties
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of properties panel.

methods.name: toggleTableOfContents
methods.description: Toggles the table of contents visibility.

methods.name: toggleEditorMargins
methods.description: Toggles editor margins.

methods.name: getActiveTab
methods.description: Returns the currently active tab.

methods.name: getActiveNote
methods.description: Returns the note in the active session.

methods.name: isNoteOpen
methods.description: Checks if a note is currently open.

methods.name: getActiveSession
methods.description: Returns the active session, optionally filtered by session types.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Adds a new tab and optionally associates it with a session.

methods.name: pinTab
methods.description: Pins or unpins a tab.

methods.name: focusTab
methods.description: Focuses a tab by ID.
